about_the_game:
The Boss is back! And he has found a new, and much bigger, factory to repurpose for the production of his cursed toys. You and your fellow workers find yourselves in the middle of the fierce competition between the monsters that haunt this new location. How many nights can you last?

In this high-stress, multitasking challenge, you are tasked by the Boss to fulfill the quotas before the time runs out. Shovel coal into the Boilers, use the wrench to fix any machines that break down and get those boxes filled up with cursed children's toys!

Each new day brings new obstacles – from the toys springing to life and terrifying Clockwork Demons disrupting the machinery to the monstrous Competitors intending to snatch you away to their mines. And... The Boss whom you must never anger too much...

Stay alert, stay vigilant and above all: always keep the production going.

Though you can work alone a team effort can truly make or break a successful business. There is plenty to do in the Factory after all, so everyone will be able to fill an essential role. And the Boss will be there to make sure everyone keeps working hard. No slackers allowed!

Do well and be rewarded with new outfits, new challenges and new Achievements as you unlock them!

Making it to the end of the most difficult shifts rewards you with a Custom mode in which you can tweak the upcoming shift entirely to your liking. Do fun challenges, or torment your friends!

Features:

  • Proximity voice chat,

  • Twitch integration with configurable commands,

  • Dynamic difficulty scaling based on team size (alone or with friends).

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Debian Bullseye or Ubuntu 20 or equivalent
  • Processor: i3 2100 or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX950 or Radeon HD 7970 with at least 3GB of VRAM
  • Additional Notes: This is the absolute minimum specs the game may run on.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Debian Bullseye or Ubuntu 20 or equivalent
  • Processor: i5 4460 or Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX1060 or RX580 with at least 4GB of VRAM

short_description: Keep a 19th century factory running at all costs in this horrifying co-op survive-the-night game. Your boss is as unforgiving as the cold steel machinery that surrounds you. Keep the Boss happy and fend off the monsters that haunt the factory as you race to produce cursed children's toys.
